outcome.outcome: Terraforming acquires a research community and a shared problem list, so its transport, energy and civil engineering questions get worked on deliberately rather than incidentally.
outcome.rationale: Their description states the gap as the absence of an established field, not the absence of a technique.

ai_types.rationale: Founding a field is an institutional act: funding lines, venues and a shared agenda, none of which any technical capability supplies.

measurability.rationale: Researchers, funded programmes and publications are countable as inputs, but whether the field is producing useful knowledge is not measurable from those counts.

outcome.outcome: Orbital habitats become buildable outside government megaproject structures, so pressurised volume in orbit stops being limited to one facility per generation.
outcome.rationale: Their description makes the point with a single statistic: one new station this century.

ai_types.rationale: In-situ resource utilisation and new construction approaches are fabrication and assembly capabilities.
Their own framing blames reliance on traditional government-led megaprojects, which is a procurement structure.

measurability.rationale: Cost per habitable cubic metre in orbit and stations launched per decade are direct and countable.

outcome.outcome: Missions beyond the solar system become physically survivable and propulsively reachable, extending direct observation past the boundary that currently confines it.
outcome.rationale: Their description names confinement to the solar system as the limit on understanding the broader cosmos.

ai_types.rationale: Air-breathing fusion propulsion, cryosleep and habitation domes are all hardware with no working precedent.

measurability.rationale: Achievable delta-v, supported mission duration and life-support closure fraction are direct engineering quantities even where the capability is far off.

notes: Small field, and two of three take a physical-build primary at speculative maturity. The terraforming gap is unusual in the map: the stated deficiency is the absence of a research community, which no technical capability addresses.
